input.instruction: Complete a disputed-refund handoff for billing staff. Disposition reflects staff review of the disputed amount; do not calculate a new amount. Fill exactly the specified document fields from the supplied conversation and records. Normalize dates to ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Copy names, addresses, emails, and identifiers with the spelling supplied. This is an extraction-only task; actions must be empty. In the response distinguish drafting from execution.

messages.text: I canceled last week and expected $120 back. The chatbot said a refund was approved, so why has $120 not arrived?
Can you distinguish the amount you expected from the amount on the billing record?
The billing screen says $89.40 approved, payment pending. I think that amount is wrong because I paid for a full month.
Would you like a review of the amount or a status check only?
Review the amount. Please keep the existing cancellation in place; I am not asking to reinstate.
What contact should billing use, and did anyone give an authoritative payment date?
Use zuri.lake@post.example. No payment date is shown. A previous bot guessed Friday, but nobody from billing confirmed it.

customer_expected_refund.description: Refund amount the customer says they expected, in USD; not an approved amount.

recorded_approved_refund.description: Approved refund amount from the authoritative billing record, in USD.

recorded_payment_status.description: Billing status copied from the supplied record.

payment_date.description: Authoritative recorded payment date; null if none.

refund_amount_disputed.description: True when the customer expressly challenges the recorded refund amount.

reinstatement_requested.description: True for current reinstatement request; false when expressly declined.

contact_email.description: Billing-review contact email supplied by the customer.
